scripts.prestart: node scripts/cleanup-legacy-dirs.mjs && node scripts/copy-kb-to-versions.mjs && node -e "if(!process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT||process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT==='changetracker'){require('child_process').execSync('npx docusaurus gen-api-docs changetracker-hub --plugin-id openapi-changetracker',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=false npx docusaurus start --port=4500 --no-open
scripts.start-chok: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx docusaurus start --port=4500 --no-open
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/cleanup-legacy-dirs.mjs && node scripts/copy-kb-to-versions.mjs && node -e "if(!process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT||process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT==='changetracker'){require('child_process').execSync('npx docusaurus gen-api-docs changetracker-hub --plugin-id openapi-changetracker',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.preci: node scripts/cleanup-legacy-dirs.mjs && node scripts/copy-kb-to-versions.mjs && node -e "if(!process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT||process.env.DOCS_PRODUCT==='changetracker'){require('child_process').execSync('npx docusaurus gen-api-docs changetracker-hub --plugin-id openapi-changetracker',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.openapi:sync: npx docusaurus clean-api-docs changetracker-hub --plugin-id openapi-changetracker && npx docusaurus gen-api-docs changetracker-hub --plugin-id openapi-changetracker && git checkout -- docs/changetracker/api/reference/_category_.json
scripts.kb:test:aa: npm run kb:clean && npm run prestart && npm run start
scripts.kb:prodtest:aa: npm run kb:clean && npm run prebuild && npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.test:scripts: bash scripts/test-slugify.sh && bash scripts/test-heading-skip.sh && bash scripts/test-md-extension-autofix.sh
